description: This Java interface defines a mutable builder pattern for constructing immutable Message objects within the Eclipse Ditto framework, supporting setting payloads, headers, and additional data.

classes.name: MessageBuilder
classes.description: A mutable builder with a fluent API for creating immutable Message instances, supporting setting payload, raw payload, headers, extra data, and response consumer.

methods.name: newHeadersBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new MessageHeadersBuilder for setting message header properties, with an overload accepting a ThingId and a deprecated version accepting a CharSequence for the Thing ID.

methods.name: payload
methods.description: Sets the payload of the message, returning the builder for chaining.

methods.name: rawPayload
methods.description: Sets the raw payload as a ByteBuffer, returning the builder for chaining.

methods.name: extra
methods.description: Sets extra data in the message, represented as a JsonObject, returning the builder for chaining.

methods.name: responseConsumer
methods.description: Stores a response consumer that is associated with the message but not serialized; marked as deprecated.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs and returns an immutable Message object based on the properties configured in the builder.
